query:
SELECT g.id, g.name
                 FROM genres g
                WHERE EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM manifestation_genres mg
                          JOIN manifestations m ON m.id = mg.manifestation_id
                         WHERE mg.genre_id = g.id
                      )
                  AND immutable_unaccent(g.name) ILIKE nullif(immutable_unaccent_like($1), '') || '%'
                ORDER BY g.name ASC
                LIMIT $2
